acceptable_use_policy: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Hingham MA PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid reason and is stored indefinitely.
hotlist_policy: Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.
overview:
The Hingham (MA) Police Department uses Flock Safety's Operating System to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. The Hingham (MA) Police Department utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, the Hingham (MA) Police Department utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals.

In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, the Hingham (MA) Police Department has made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.
